body:
[A10] READY DECISION - sanitizer instrumentation belongs to the named targets

Selected policy: ASan/UBSan variant libraries and the test translation units consuming their compile requirements must receive the matching instrumentation independently of CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE, including the empty default. Keep existing per-configuration optimization/debug choices, test registration, ordinary consumer targets, embedded/tests-off behavior, protocol values and frame assertions unchanged. Do not set a global default build type or globally instrument ordinary targets. Preserve the existing source-population boundaries; adding sanitized protocol_logic or third-party builds is out of scope.

The issue's observation reproduces at current main `deca300c9eb4863fa13383b45ba6cb6fd0828671`: actual generated ptp_flags ASAN/UBSAN compile commands lack -fsanitize with an empty type and include it in Debug, Release, MinSizeRel and RelWithDebInfo; both link commands carry it in every configuration. [Configure-only receipts](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-gen/tree/8a9321146bd993a68c251d03719ec608cd96c105/readiness-evidence/15). No repaired behavior is claimed by this measurement. [CMake's target option contract](https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/command/target_compile_options.html) and [ASan's compile/link requirements](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/AddressSanitizer.html#usage) support applying this to target compilation separately from linkage.

Validation is frozen before takeover: inspect the complete generated instrumented library/test compile population and actual link commands for empty and all four standard configurations; run independent normal and diagnostic behavior controls through the actual helpers, proving they detect removal of instrumentation; preserve plain and embedded/tests-off consumers; run default and explicit Debug native unit tests plus both documented BDD suites, and all existing hosted jobs. Record exact diagnostic/exit behavior. UBSan commonly recovers by default ([official behavior](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.html#usage)); use an explicitly recorded fatal setting for its negative behavior control and describe actual normal test semantics accurately. Do not silently turn stderr matching into a synthetic child exit or broaden the task into a global recovery-policy change. Direct runner exits are evidence; setup.sh's final command alone is not a substitute for the separately invoked tests/run-tests.sh.

No design choice remains for this issue. Executor A162 (Opus); independent reviewers R231 (cold internal Opus) and R232 (external Codex). No active PR conflicts. This lane is independent of parent CI pins/parser work and donor pp_top. Source branch is created from live main after this decision. Full review, candidate and containment bar still applies; no test is weakened to obtain a pass.
